href="https://feddet.dk">Home</a><span class="separator"> &ndash; </span><a href="https://feddet.dk/en/activities/">Activities</a><span class="separator"> &ndash; </span><span class="last">Kite elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" id="content"> <div class="elementor-background-overlay"></div> <div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default"> <div elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" id="content"> <div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default"> <div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-18d318e5"> <div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-fb96fab elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Kite surfing / Windsurfing</h1> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d5a9ce9 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <div class="elementor-divider"> <span class="elementor-divider-separator"> </span> </div> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4244ce42 elementor-widget elementor-widget-theme-post-content"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <p class="p1">Feddet is one of the best places in South Zealand for kitesurfing.</p>
<p class="p1">In westerly winds you can use the spot at Fedhavnen and surf in Præstø Fjord &#8211; in easterly winds you can surf from the stand in Faxe bay. At the harbor there is a small beach where you can start directly, a cozy environment as well as toilet and campfire hut. Here you can eat the packed lunch in shelter after a good trip on the water. The fjord around Feddet is very shallow &#8211; so the place is good for beginners.</p>
<p>To Kitesurf, you must bring your own equipment.</p>
<p>Day pass per day: Charged per hour, but for a maximum of 4 hours. See current rates <a href="https://feddet.dk/en/practical-information/parking-at-feddet/">here.</a> </p>
<p class="p1">Annual pass: 995,- DKK. Day and annual card can be purchased in the information at Feddet Strand Resort, Feddet 12, DK 4640 Faxe</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-dd32ab6 elementor-invisible"> <div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"> <div class="elementor-element class="elementor-swiper-button elementor-swiper-button-prev"> <svg></svg> </div> <div class="elementor-swiper-button elementor-swiper-button-next"> <svg></svg> </div> <div class="swiper-pagination"></div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </section> <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-4656c14 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default"> <div class="elementor-background-overlay"></div> <div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default"> <div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-6b5e9ef"> <div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2597213 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h3 class="p4"><b>Kitesurfing with the kite collective</b></h3>
<p class="p1">Feddet Strand Resort collaborates with Kitekollektivet. Read more here about the many opportunities for participation in courses both within kitesurfing and <a href="https://feddet.dk/en/?post_type=aktiviteter&amp;p=4538"><span class="s1">SUP (Stand Up Paddleboard).</span></a></p>
<p class="p1">If you want to feel the adrenaline, hear the waves of the sea and feel the sun&#8217;s rays on your cheeks, then kitesurfing on Feddet with Kitekollektivet is the obvious option. As Feddet is located next to the low-lying Præstø Fjord, Feddet is the ideal place for kitesurfing.</p>
<p class="p1">At Kitekollektivet, private courses, partner, group and team tutoring are offered. So there is ample opportunity to assess how you prefer to start your trip on the water. Do you want a 1: 1 teaching for the first time or a fun day with a boyfriend or friend, where there is an opportunity to spar and share the experience, or should the whole group of friends go together? <a href="https://kitekollektivet.dk/kitesurfing-kurser/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Read more about the possibilities for a kitesurfing course here</a> .</p>
<p class="p1">Our skilled instructors are ready to receive you and refine your techniques or help you get started with the sport for the first time. If you want an activity for the whole group of friends or your whole team, then activities are also offered for up to 10 people, where kitesurfing courses or SUP teaching or rental of SUP equipment can be arranged. Finally, contact us by phone and we can tailor this option for you.</p>
<p class="p1">Our skilled, certified instructors are ready to receive you and refine your techniques or help you get started in the sport for the first time. All you need to bring is good mood and swimwear.</p>
<p class="p1">Since Kitekollektivet was founded with an ambition to create a strong community on the Zealand beaches, you also have the opportunity to become a member, where there are benefits such as discounts on courses, the opportunity to participate in social events and become a member of the internal Facebook group with tips &#038; tricks. Membership costs 500 DKK per year and includes a rashguard.</p>
<p class="p1"><b>Private course 1: 1 </b></p>
<p class="p1">5 hours 2750 DKK<br />
10 hours 5250 DKK</p>
<p class="p1"><b>Makes course 2 people</b></p>
<p class="p1">5 hours 1474 DKK<br />
10 hours 2950 DKK</p>
<p class="p1"><b>Group course 3-10 people</b></p>
<p class="p1">Arrange, call and have a chat with us.</p>
<p class="p1"><b>Booking, prices and information</b></p>
<p class="p1">+45 38 42 99 98</p>
<p class="p6"><span class="s2"><a href="http://www.kitekollektivet.dk/">www.kitekollektivet.dk</a></span></p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </section> <section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-f15f5ff elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default elementor-invisible"> <div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default"> <div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-80c71a9"> <div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5a18ecf elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor"> <div class="elementor-widget-container"> <h2>Surf and stay at Feddet Strand Resort</h2>
<p>Why not combine sports and holidays? We offer several types of accommodation, so you can stay close to one of South Zealand&#8217;s best kitesurfing areas. You can bring your own caravan or motorhome or book yourself in one of our beautiful cabins or holiday homes.</p>
<p>If you are a larger group, you can e.g. be up to 8 people in our holiday homes.</p>
<p>An active holiday can also include relaxation, luxury and well-being. You get it all at Feddet Strand Resort. When the day has passed with a whole lot of hours of surfing in the fjord, you can enjoy delicious food in Restaurant Feddet and relaxing treatments in wellness.</p>
<p>If you have not finished being active at all, we also have a large fitness center. And nature also invites to good walks or other activities such as. biking.</p>
<h2>Active kitesurfing holiday</h2>
<p>Do you dream of an active holiday? Should something happen on the water? Feddet Strand Resort offers good opportunities for kitesurfing holidays in South Zealand, more specifically the peninsula Feddet. Our place is located close to water and beach. You can therefore easily take kitesurfing equipment with you on holiday and enjoy the waves and wind. Both Præstø Fjord and Fedhavnen are obvious places for kitesurfing with westerly winds &#8211; in Faxe Bay you get the easterly winds with you.</p>
<p>Buy day passes or annual passes, depending on how often you holiday at our campsite. It is entirely up to you whether you just want to go out on the waves a single day or every single day of the holiday. We offer wonderful accommodation options for you who want an action-packed holiday with kitesurfing. Bring your friends or family and have a wonderful holiday in the most natural surroundings.</p>
<h2>Exciting kitesurfing holiday with accommodation</h2>
<p>Our kitesurfing trips offer a little of everything. In addition to getting some of the best places in South Zealand to kite surf, you also get really nice accommodation options. At Feddet Strand Resort, which is a 5-star site, you can spend the night in everything from your own caravan or motorhome to beach houses, holiday cabins and holiday homes. It&#8217;s up to you how luxurious it should be. We always have a good accommodation option that suits your needs.</p>
<p>Kitesurfing has never been easier on vacation. Just take the car down to Fedhavnen, Præstø Fjord or Faxe bay. It is all three places with good opportunities to get wind in the sail. If you are out all day, you can make a good packed lunch and enjoy it in nature at Feddet. At the harbor you will find both toilet facilities and a campfire hut. When you are tired after a day on the waves, you can enjoy peace and relaxation at our scenic campsite.</p>
<h2>Kitesurfing holiday with luxury accommodation</h2>
<p>Lovely accommodation is not the only luxury in our place. There are several good reasons why our campsite has achieved a full 5 stars. If the wind is not right for it one day, you can among other things enjoy:</p>
<h4>Pool, fitness and wellness</h4>
<p>Get right down to gear and relax in our pool and wellness area. Here you can swim a few lanes or get the pulse down in the sauna. If you want to keep the active level, you can take advantage of our modern fitness center.</p>
<h4>Hiking in nature</h4>
<p>Are you just a natural person? Why not switch the surfboard out with a set of hiking boots every now and then. If the wind is not there, you can still get out and be active, experience nature on Feddet. The area around the site offers a wealth of good walking routes, and we also have one of Denmark&#8217;s best beaches just a stone&#8217;s throw from the site.</p>
<h4>Other experiences on the water (kayaking and fishing)</h4>
<p>If you&#8217;re just a bit of a water dog, you can also frolic with other fun activities on the water. The area around us also invites to kayaking around the whole of Feddet or a good fishing trip with friends or family.</p>
<p>You can also just relax in your holiday cottage &#8211; maybe you have chosen one with a nice terrace or whirlpool? We have many luxurious accommodation options with room for more overnight stays. So take either your family or your kitesurfing friends on holiday. There is plenty of space for cozy gatherings when you do not want to be active on the waves. And does the food need to be easy? Then you can visit the sites restaurant or shop in our local supermarket.</p>
<h2>Kitesurf holiday in South Zealand</h2>
<p>Are you looking for a wonderful resort where you can also enjoy your hobby, kitesurfing? Feddet Strand Resort is the obvious place on Zealand. We are located only 1 hour drive from Copenhagen. You do not have to drive far to get away from the big city and enjoy nature and fun on the water. Whether it&#8217;s just going to be for a weekend or for several weeks in the summer, it&#8217;s up to you.</p>
<p>Book your kitesurfing holiday with experiences and accommodation at Feddet Strand Resort today! We guarantee a fantastic holiday with unforgettable moments.</p> </div> </div> <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4ca94db elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading">
